content: In this paper, we present a demo system based on an alternative approach to task-oriented dialogue. Relying on non-generative response retrieval we describe the PolyResponse conversational search engine and its application in the task of restaurant search and booking. The engine is trained on hundreds of millions of real conversations from a general domain (i.e., Reddit), using an implicit representation of semantics that directly optimizes the task at hand. It learns what responses are appropriate in different conversational contexts, and consequently ranks a large pool of responses according to their relevance to the current user utterance and previous dialogue history (i.e., dialogue context).
